description: PROPOSED (Discussion #118), not yet finalized. A runner executing llm_judge graders self-reports the judge identity it actually observed under metadata.openeval.judge on each GraderResult, as distinct from the model the suite requested in the grader's params.model. The first grader records a pinned model with a fingerprint and says how the fingerprint was computed; the second records that the temperature was inherited from the provider default rather than set. The first grader's fingerprint shape follows Proofspan's published docs (<model>@sha256:<hash of the provider model-card body>); the hash here is a placeholder, not a real digest, and this document was not produced by a run of Proofspan. Every key is optional and none is validated, so a conforming validator MUST ACCEPT this document; both validation paths do.

results.actual_output: Paris is the capital of France.

judge.fingerprint_method: sha256 of the GET /v1/models/<id> response body
